scripts.dev: bun run build:lib && bun run --cwd examples/showcase dev
scripts.test: bun run build:lib && bun run --cwd examples/showcase test
scripts.build: bun run build:lib && bun run build:showcase
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['dist', 'packages/teal-ink/dist', 'examples/showcase/dist', 'node_modules/.vite', 'examples/showcase/node_modules/.vite']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.ci: bun run lint && bun run check && bun run test && bun run build && bun run security
